visualCharacteristics.feature-links: Text-only white tiles (title, short description, chevron CTA link); directly after a gallery in the same section they overlap its lower edge on desktop
visualCharacteristics.icon-tiles: Borderless tiles: small centered icon, centered H3 title and rich description; 3-column wrapping grid from 900px (2 from 600px, 1 on mobile); tile counts vary (3, 5, 6, 8)
visualCharacteristics.video-tiles: Square thumbnail with a white circular play icon and a blue (#0071bc) title bar; the card's youtube.com/watch link opens an accessible modal video player (native <dialog>, iframe loaded on click, Esc/close restores focus)

contentPattern.structure: one row per card; optional image cell, then a body cell with title heading, description paragraph and a CTA link in its own paragraph
contentPattern.example: 3 feature link tiles: 'Life at Blue Shield', 'Our people', 'Serving our communities'
contentPattern.icon-tiles: one row per tile: icon image cell, body cell with H3 title and description paragraph(s) (links allowed)
contentPattern.video-tiles: one row per video: thumbnail image cell, body cell with H3 title linked to a youtube.com/watch URL (or the title plus a separate paragraph holding the YouTube link)

notes: Homepage feature tiles under the gallery: authored as 'Cards (feature-links)'
How to get hired: 6 hiring-process steps, authored as 'Cards (icon-tiles)' (variant cards-icon-tiles)

reuseGuidance: Use 'Cards (feature-links)' for text-only link tiles. Place it right after a Gallery block in the same section to get the overlap. Image cards keep using plain 'Cards'. Use 'icon-tiles' for icon + title + description grids (use the Article List block for story cards), and 'video-tiles' for YouTube thumbnails that play in a modal.
